shots.description: Cover: five-star sunset chase on Sunset Strip, helicopter overhead, roadblock ahead, full HUD with mission header, NBPD dispatch panel, stars, cash, weapon slots, minimap, speed and Lena dialogue.
Street driving on Sunset Strip with traffic cars and pedestrians on the sidewalks, mission 1 active.
Close pursuit: three-star chase in Palm Court with two interceptor units on the bumper and the helicopter spotlight.
Mission moment on foot at the Docks: recovering the stash inside the objective marker while Cole briefs Rook, three-star heat.
